notes: Node ids: main run scenes keep their run.json id; path scenes are "<path>:<id>"; Bassment passages are "bassment:<n>".

Edge condition.outcome: on_pass = the last block was passed when committed (>=60% mean credit); on_miss = failed; test_pass/test_fail = Bassment rhythm tests; take/win_or_take = Bassment plain choice or fight (fight lost 3 times => death passage 0).
continues_by_default_exit=true: the hotspot has no route of its own for that outcome; the scene ends by its default exit, so the edge goes to the default destination.

Edges via "pause menu: Leave this path" exist for every scene of gospel/squadron/ember, available from beat 61 of a lap; edges via "system back key" exist for every Bassment passage (Esc/Android back, no on-screen button found).

Quest category names: quest_bassment=Dungeon/Basement, quest_gospel=Jesus, quest_squadron=Catch-22 analogue, quest_ember=Lord of the Rings analogue, dev_stub=developer test path (not reachable in the shipped run).
All hotspots in the same scene share one final-window commit per visit (one touch decides the exit), so edges from one scene are alternatives, not a sequence.

min_choices_from_start_to_entry.method: Dijkstra over (scene, run flags); one choice = one hotspot commit (a door, person or object touched, or the default taken); assumes every touch is passed; counts the touch that enters the quest
min_choices_from_start_to_entry.note: Gospel and Ember need a second visit to the Balcony/Bar in the same run, which only exists after a trip back to the Floor; the cheapest trip is the wizard + the Bassment back key (hidden). With track packs present the Balcony/Bar laps may allow rail+star in one visit (unverified).
